purpose: Read-only age and timestamp visibility for deployment observations, human review activity, pending candidates and certification completion.

bands.meaning: At least 24 hours but less than 7 days old.
The workflow timestamp does not apply to the current app state.

rules: Age is elapsed time from an explicit UTC timestamp to a supplied report asOf time.
Age bands are operational visibility only and are not security risk scores.
Deployment age uses the latest deployment observation observedAt.
Pending-candidate age uses the pending candidate observedAt.
Human-review age uses lastActivityAt for an in-progress Human Diff Review v1.2 and accepted reviewedAt when evidence is accepted; reviews not yet started remain unknown.
Certification completion uses the latest accepted review decision decidedAt that matches the app's currently reviewed release when available.
Legacy reviewed apps without an authoritative dated accepted decision report certification age as unknown.
nonClaims: Older does not mean less secure.
Unknown age does not mean stale.
A recent deployment observation does not prove continuous runtime health.
Certification age does not replace deployment identity comparison.
